{"requirements": [
{"id": 1, "text": "The program shall grow the length of the snake by making the snake eat food until it fills the entire board."},
{"id": 2, "text": "The program shall make the snake eat food when it touches the food."},
{"id": 3, "text": "Every time the snake eats a piece of food, the program shall increase the length of the snake's body by one block."},
{"id": 4, "text": "The program shall prevent the snake from touching a board side."},
{"id": 5, "text": "The program shall end the game as soon as the snake's body is touched."},
{"id": 6, "text": "The program shall create a game board with k x k blocks, where k is given as input by the user."},
{"id": 7, "text": "The program shall initialise the board with a snake and a piece of food, represented as a single green block at the bottom left square of the board."},
{"id": 8, "text": "The program shall allow the user to move the snake by pressing up, down, right, or left on the keyboard."},
{"id": 9, "text": "The program shall make a new piece of food appear every time the snake eats a piece of food."},
{"id": 10, "text": "The program shall increase the snake's speed by 10 milliseconds every time the snake eats a piece of food."},
{"id": 11, "text": "The program shall set the initial speed of the snake to 0.5 blocks per second if the user selects 'easy' difficulty."},
{"id": 12, "text": "The program shall make a blue bonus piece of food appear after the snake has eaten many pieces of food."},
{"id": 13, "text": "The program shall make a golden bonus block appear at a random position on the board."},
{"id": 14, "text": "The program shall pause the game when the user presses 'p' on the keyboard and resume the game when the user presses 'q' on the keyboard."}
]}
